name: sandbox_run_status
description: State of a sandbox_run: ACCEPTED (being started), RUNNING (started; a GUI program stays here while open), SUCCEEDED or FAILED (ended; exit_code and stdout from the Sandbox's checked receipt), DENIED (not started), HELD (its result could not pass the Host's checks) or UNKNOWN (it may have run; never run it again to find out). Calling it again is safe. A command-line run (code, a project) usually takes 20 seconds to a few minutes (installing libraries and building take longer): keep calling with wait_ms 30000 until it is SUCCEEDED or FAILED; do not report a result while it is ACCEPTED or RUNNING.

wait_ms.description: Wait up to this long for the run to end before answering (a code run usually takes 20-60 s; use 30000 and call again while it is still ACCEPTED or RUNNING).
